pairs.difference: A is the real lighthouse from the lessons. Its tower is a light band of whites and mid-greys against a mid-grey sky, and the only darks are the gallery and the red bands. B's house breaks into many scattered dark pieces: the roof, the tree canopies, the door and a dark grass rim at the bottom. The moon makes a bright white disc in the upper right that competes with the lit windows, so no single light group carries the card.
pairs.fix: Keep the house as one mid-light mass against a lighter sky. Lighten the roof and tree canopies to mid tones, remove the dark band of grass at the bottom edge, and make the lit windows the only near-white spots.

pairs.difference: A: a light diagonal ray band in the upper left against darker blue lower corners, with a mid-value seahorse and a dark eye accent. B: mid sky, light cloud mass across the bottom, and balloons in mid-to-dark values with small white highlights. Both value layouts sit inside the real-card ranges, and neither shows the glow-behind-the-hero tell.

A: the red gloves are a mid-dark mass against mid-grey wall stripes and a light wooden floor. The value steps are simple, though the corners are slightly light. B: the cauldron is a near-black mass taking about a third of the card, sitting on a dark tiled floor, with only the light rim and liquid breaking it. Dark hero on dark floor gives weak hero-to-ground separation, and the pink wall strip is the only light area.
pairs.fix: Lighten the floor tiles to a pale mid tone so the black pot stands out against them. Give the pot a broad soft highlight on its upper side so it reads as dark grey, not solid black.

pairs.difference: A: the duck is a light mass over alternating light and dark rays, with dark accents limited to the eye and the spring. B: the pumpkin is a mid-light mass with a lit face as the lightest shape. A hard near-black shadow band runs under it, the dark plank lines read as stripes, and a lighter halo zone sits behind the pumpkin under dark upper corners, which is the generated glow-behind-hero pattern from the lessons.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright halo behind the pumpkin and keep the rays evenly alternating to the corners. Soften the black shadow under the pumpkin into a mid-grey contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A: the fountain is a light mass on a light striped wall and pavement, with gentle mid-grey water shading. B: the black cat is one huge near-black silhouette, with white eye discs as the only light inside it. The gap between hero and background is far outside the real range, and so is the overall contrast. No real card puts that much area at the darkest level.
pairs.fix: Paint the cat as charcoal grey with broad lighter grey highlights on the head, back and paws, so most of its body sits in the middle tones and only small creases go near black.

pairs.difference: A: the sneakers are a mid-dark mass with white soles, set on a light floor below a mid-grey wall, with a clear horizon split. B: the grey tombstone is a mid-light hero inside a light glow halo that hugs its outline against a slightly darker background. The card is overall brighter than the real range, and the hero is separated mainly by that halo, not by its own value.
pairs.fix: Remove the pale glow around the tombstone and give the background an even, slightly darker orange. Shade the stone's right side and base a step darker so it separates by its own light and dark faces.

pairs.difference: Both cards put a dark hero on concentric rings, and both have hero-to-background gaps darker than the real range. A: the witch hat is mostly near-black, with only the buckle and band light, and the dark brim covers the lower third. B: the cap is dark, but it sits on a centred light disc. A has the larger area of the darkest value.
pairs.fix: Lift the hat to a dark purple-grey with a broad soft highlight along the cone and the brim's top, keeping only the brim's underside near black.

pairs.difference: A: the whole card is black at the corners and edges, the darkest key in the set and far below the real range. The candelabra is white and light grey on that black, giving an extreme light-hero gap and spotlight tenebrism. B: mid-grey rays with a light ray burst behind the lamp, inside the real ranges.
pairs.fix: Brighten the purple background to a medium violet with clearly lighter rays reaching all the way to the corners. Do not let the edges fall to black.

pairs.difference: A: a light stone table on mid-grey grass, with dark tree shadows spread around the card and checkerboard darks as small accents. B: the coffin's right side and its inner lining form a tall dark vertical band against mid grass. The front face is mid-dark, so the hero reads darker than its ground, and the white cross and white moon are isolated lights.
pairs.fix: Light the coffin's front face to a warm mid-light tone and its side to mid grey, so it is lighter than the grass. Let the cross be the lightest shape on it.

pairs.difference: A: the glass and ice are a bright mass on a dark checker background. That is a big hero-to-background gap, a simple light-on-dark layout like the real flower-bed and lion cards. B: the crystal ball is broken into many small, hard light and dark swirls and specular patches inside the sphere. It sits over a dark band of shelf, so the hero has busy local contrast and no single value group.
pairs.fix: Fill the crystal ball with one soft mid-light value with a single broad highlight, and remove the many sharp dark and light swirls inside it.

pairs.difference: A: very low contrast, far below the real range. The broom handle is a thin mid-grey stroke almost matching the light-grey wave background, with only the light bristles separating. B: the scarf is a clear dark mass on a light swirl, with a light emblem accent, inside the real ranges.
pairs.fix: Make the background waves a calmer, slightly darker blue so the broom stands out. Give the handle a light top edge and a darker underside, and the bristles a darker band under the binding.

pairs.difference: A: a very light card, brighter than the real range, with the flip-flops light on light stripes. The straps are near white, and a lighter glow patch sits at the top behind the hero. B: a mid-dark room with stacked books in mid-dark values, bright page edges and a light window. The grouping is clear and inside the real ranges.
pairs.fix: Lower the background stripes to a medium teal, remove the pale glow behind the sandals, and shade the soles' undersides a step darker.

pattern: Generated cards push the darkest value too far and over too much area: near-black heroes like the cat, cauldron and witch hat, or black card edges like the candelabra. They also show a pale glow halo hugging the hero instead of rays or patterns that run evenly to the corners. Some instead go too light or too flat overall, like the broom, tombstone and flip-flops, with the hero separated by that halo or by hue rather than by its own light and dark faces.
